description: Cost-aware learn loop: compose reports per-step usage (S0), stratum harvests + classifies cost waste (retry-waste/outlier/model-mismatch) into templated notes (S1/S2), and mirrors step_usage + cost_candidate events into SmartMemory via the policy outbox (S1b). Egress only — the learn author never reads SmartMemory. Extends STRAT-TS-LEARN.
